solution:
The correct answer is __**1-b, 2-c, 3-a.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Cold humid winter** with short summer present in Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• **Hot desert** in Extreme Western Rajasthan.
 
• **Monsoon with dry summer** in the Coromandel coast of Tamil Nadu. Because of the **north-east monsoons**, this Indian coastline stays dry in summer and receives rainfall during the winters.
